page.notes: Doubtful readings: "sese" (printed with long s, looks like "fefe"); "maximè" is split across the line end "maxi / mè" with no clear printed hyphen, so it is written whole; "q;" before "ita" is a printed abbreviation that may be a ligature. Printed accents and macrons are copied as they appear, and the catchword rule does not apply to "& ab", which is the last full line of text.
